declared: 2026-11-01, before any model run on these regions (only their grids and WorldClim coverage were built: nova_scotia 86, middle_volga 256, tripolitania 195, bc_coast 198, tibet_plateau 256, ethiopia_highlands 255 scored land cells at 56 km)
why: Sealed set b (calibration/sealed_20261031b) was run once for the r41 adoption (S 0.9872) and is development data from now on.
chosen_for: six climates no earlier scored box covers: a cold-sea east coast (Nova Scotia, the e64/e67 shelf and continental-air terms), continental forest steppe (middle Volga), the Mediterranean-to-desert edge the invented map paints in its south (Tripolitania), a hypermaritime fjord coast (northern British Columbia), cold high plateau (Tibet) and tropical highland with a summer monsoon (Ethiopia); none overlaps the scored box of any of the 49 earlier regions (checked against every region file in calibration/ and rotclimate/earth.py REGIONS)
rules: Never tuned on and never used to design a mechanism. Run once per candidate that has passed the development gate and the 28 km check, paired against the adopted profile; adoption requires them not to get worse (S <= 1). Every result is reported.
